_comment: The starting role: the floor every new member has, and what the gym-badge
ladder in discord-badges.json promotes FROM. It is not a ninth badge, so it
lives in its own file with its own colour, clearly distinct from all eight
badge colours so it never reads as an earned rank.
That flag shares the exact role-sync machinery --badges uses (see
fm-dc-setup.sh's apply_role_file), so this file is idempotent the same way:
a second run updates the colour if it drifted and creates nothing new.
Granting this role automatically, on join, is NOT done by this file or by
fm-dc-setup.sh - creating the role and assigning it to new members are two
different actions. See docs/discord.md's welcome-experience section for
